description: This file is a Node.js script written in JavaScript for automating build checks, managing snapshots of directory states, running timed watch commands, and generating a summary report for a regression testing process related to a gateway system.

methods.name: parseArgs
methods.description: Parses command line arguments to override default options.

methods.name: ensureDir
methods.description: Creates a directory and any necessary parent directories.

methods.name: normalizePath
methods.description: Replaces backslashes with forward slashes in file paths.

methods.name: listTreeEntries
methods.description: Lists all entries in a directory tree starting from a root directory.

methods.name: humanBytes
methods.description: Converts a byte count into a human-readable string.

methods.name: snapshotTree
methods.description: Generates a snapshot object containing statistics of directory contents.

methods.name: writeSnapshot
methods.description: Writes snapshot data and file paths to a designated directory.

methods.name: runCheckedCommand
methods.description: Executes a command synchronously and throws on failure.

methods.name: sleep
methods.description: Returns a promise that resolves after a specified number of milliseconds.

methods.name: buildTimedWatchCommand
methods.description: Builds a command object to run a timed watch script with resource usage measurement.

methods.name: parseTimingFile
methods.description: Parses a timing log file produced by the watch command.

methods.name: runTimedWatch
methods.description: Runs a watch process with timing and instrumentation, managing termination signals.

methods.name: parsePathFile
methods.description: Reads a list of file paths from a text file.

methods.name: writeDiffArtifacts
methods.description: Computes differences between two directory snapshots and writes added/removed paths.

methods.name: fail
methods.description: Logs a failure message to standard error.

methods.name: detectWatchBuildReason
methods.description: Analyzes stdout and stderr logs to determine if a build was triggered by a stale directory.

methods.name: buildRunNodeDeps
methods.description: Constructs environment and path configurations needed for build dependencies.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution function orchestrating the build check process, snapshots, running watch, analysis, and reporting.
